description: This file defines a class TransactionRootGrain implementing ITransactionRootGrain interface, used within an Orleans-based distributed system for transaction management. It contains a method Run that initiates transactions on a list of grains.

classes.name: TransactionRootGrain
classes.description: A reentrant, stateless grain that manages initiating transactions on multiple grains.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Initiates a transaction on each grain ID in the list by calling their Run method asynchronously.
